content: Model performance also clearly degrades for hypernymy and hyponymy across all models as the number of hops $k$ increases (see red dashed boxes). For example, problems that involve hyponym reasoning with sister distractors of distance $k^{\prime }=1$ (i.e., the second column) degrades from 47% to 15% when the number of hops $k$ increases from 1 to 4. This general tendency persists even after additional fine-tuning, as we discuss next, and gives evidence that models are limited in their capacity for certain types of multi-hop inferences.
